public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every AI startup other than OpenAI, Cursor and Anthropic is making single- or double-digit millions of dollars in revenue and losing hundreds of millions of dollars to get there.
conditions: everybody else besides OpenAI, Cursor and Anthropic

statement.excerpt: Otherwise, everybody else is making single or double-digit millions of dollars and losing hundreds of millions of dollars to get there.

from_speaker: making single or double-digit millions of dollars
losing hundreds of millions of dollars
our_interpretation: The surrounding paragraph makes OpenAI, Cursor and Anthropic the exceptions. Read everybody else as other AI startups, rather than established technology conglomerates.
The ordinary literal reading is a universal statement, so one comparable counterexample would defeat it.
Use calendar 2025, the latest completed annual reporting period before the post, because the surrounding discussion concerns annual industry revenue. The sentence itself supplies no period.

Read single- or double-digit millions as at least $1 million and below $100 million in realized annual revenue, and hundreds of millions as at least $200 million and below $1 billion in annual losses.
The statement gives no accounting basis or definition of losses. Nearby references to reported revenues do not establish a common accounting basis for this universal claim.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records show that every startup in the stated population had annual revenue and losses within the asserted ranges.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified startup within the population had revenue or losses outside the asserted ranges on the same period and accounting basis. Under the supplied rules, a decisive grade also requires resolving the claim's unknown accounting basis.
